family_name: Bradford Wall Wraps - Medium Duty Polyweave Wall Wrap

spec.description:
Bradford Thermoseal Medium Duty Polyweave Wall Wrap is a
heavy-duty, tear-resistant reflective foil laminate designed for use in exterior
walls with framing cavities. Built with high-strength woven polymer (polyweave)
fabric bonded to pure aluminium foil with flame-retardant adhesive, it provides
high puncture resistance against construction traffic and high winds. When
installed adjacent to an internal or external air cavity, its reflective
aluminium facing generates thermal air-gap R-values while forming a Class 1/2
vapour barrier and liquid water barrier.
features:

install:
Fix Thermoseal Polyweave Wall Wrap to
exterior of studs starting from bottom plate

Run sheets horizontally with
upper sheets overlapping lower sheets by minimum 150mm

Ensure orientation
matches product design (foil facing cavity where reflective R-value is
desired)

Secure to timber framing using galvanized staples or clouts; use
self-drilling screws with washers for steel

Fix at maximum 300mm centres to
studs and plates to prevent wind flap

Seal joints with Bradford 493
reinforced aluminium foil tape for maximum vapour and air tightness
selection_checklist:
Confirm wall type is brick veneer or cavity
construction where air space exists

Choose between Inward Reflective (when
stud cavity is empty) or Outward XP (when stud is filled with batts)

Select
roll length (30m for 40.5m² or 60m for 81m²)

Verify Medium Duty rating is
specified for high wind or exposed sites
limitations:
Requires an air gap
(void) adjacent to the reflective face to deliver thermal R-value

Non-breathable vapour barrier; not recommended in cold climate zones
(zones 6, 7, 8) where Class 4 breathable wraps are mandated

Must be covered
by external cladding within manufacturer UV exposure limits
spec.warranty: Backed by CSR Bradford product warranty

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford
Wall Wraps - Medium Duty Polyweave Wall Wrap (Bradford Thermoseal Wall Wrap /
Wall Wrap XP, product codes 15128 / 40483 / 124652) is an ultra-tough,
tear-resistant reflective foil laminate designed for exterior brick veneer and
cavity wall construction. Constructed with a high-density woven polymer core and
pure aluminium foil, its Medium Duty rating resists wind flapping and tearing on
exposed jobsites while acting as an effective water and vapour barrier. By
reflecting radiant heat across adjacent air cavities, it boosts wall thermal
performance and complies with AS/NZS 4200.1 and AS 1530.2 (Flammability Index
≤ 5, BAL 12.5-40).
